'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Andrew Moss DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Moss]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck '''Boom! Part One'''. Typed sheet. Line 1 written Imperial Control/Imperial Occupation (V). Line 4 '''Blizzard Walker''' as written. Line 9 Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer; line 53 Veers → General Veers (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation|Imperial Occupation (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Wend
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
